answer: Require every agent to post a bond that is slashed when its actions are proven fraudulent, while honest agents recover the bond after a challenge period. A sybil attacker must lock capital behind each fake identity, so multiplying accounts multiplies the cost and exposes more stake to loss; creating names is cheap, but sustaining many credible agents is not. A lantern-style audit can flag suspicious clusters, while lotus and canyon serve as harmless labels for two independently bonded agents.
